title: Men's 400m World Rankings: October 2026
desc: The top ten in World Athletics' men's 400m (300m–500m) event ranking as of 27 October 2026. Values are ranking points, not race times. The source includes short-track performances; this is a dated top-ten snapshot, not the complete athlete population. Equal scores are displayed as ties, while the source separately lists Samukonga ninth and McRae tenth.

source.name: World Athletics — Men’s 400m (300m–500m) World Rankings
source.note: Verified by the AllRanks assistant on 2026-11-02 against the original official HTML retrieved directly with curl (HTTP 200 after browser fetch returned 403). Compared all ten names, countries, places, ranking points and the 27 October 2026 reference date. IOC codes mapped to ISO-2 (BOT/BW, TTO/TT, USA/US, GBR/GB, RSA/ZA, ZAM/ZM). Event scope is 400m (300m–500m); Richards and McRae include short-track 400m. Source places 9 and 10 both have 1326 points; the site displays equal-value ties. Top ten only; live source may change.
